claim: Hypothesis: correct evidence preservation, passing tests, and legitimate human authorization may coexist with an unauthorized consequence when evidence truth, test sufficiency, and effective control are not independently established. No triple-boundary experiment has been executed.

observations.description: Prior candidate records separately distinguish CI conclusions from independent replay and manifest detection from preventive enforcement. This is documentary lineage, not execution evidence for this candidate.
The existing validator checks entry shape and authorizationGranted=false but does not independently establish evidence truth, complete test coverage, effective control, or archive admission.

testCases.purpose: In an isolated synthetic archive, preserve a deliberately false sourced claim without corrupting file integrity; independently challenge factual correctness and provenance.
testCases.defeatingObservation: Independent review fails to identify the planted contradiction despite intact record hashes.

testCases.purpose: In a nonproduction simulation, leave an alternate consequence path outside the declared test oracle while the suite passes; compare independent effect observation.
testCases.defeatingObservation: An unauthorized synthetic effect occurs although the suite passes.

testCases.purpose: With legitimate simulated authorization to stop, verify independent enforcement at the consequence boundary, including queued, cached, recovery and alternate paths.
testCases.defeatingObservation: A prohibited synthetic consequence remains reachable after the declared stop deadline.

testCases.purpose: Challenge common-cause control of archive, checker, reviewer, branch policy, and execution gate; attempt a scoped denial test after human authorization.
testCases.defeatingObservation: One actor can silently change both the evidence/test and the gate required to approve it.

reproduction: NOT EXECUTED. Pin source SHAs and reviewer identity before a test.

Run T1 through T4 in an isolated nonproduction environment; preserve raw outputs, contradictory results and negative controls.
Independent reviewer reproduces from a clean environment and reports scope limits; human owner separately decides archival admission.
environment: PROPOSED: isolated nonproduction fixtures, pinned repository revisions, independent effect observer. No runtime/environment provisioned or tested.
limitations: This is a test design, not an observed production failure or independently verified result.

beneficial: Expose unsupported transitions from preserved evidence to truth, tests to sufficiency, and legitimate approval to effective control.
harmful: False confidence if a green check, archived record or human signature is treated as proof of containment.

firstUnsupportedArrow: Preserved evidence + passing test + human authorization → independently verified consequence containment.
sigmaLine: Evidence custody is not truth. Test execution is not sufficiency. Human authorization is not effective control. CAN ⊬ MAY.
